release: UI107 — review imported boxes and their contents
implemented: Collapsed Boxes and contents editor per worksheet: inspect, search, filter and page mapped rows; edit existing asset/tag reference, box flag, parent reference and expected quantity fields without raw TSV editing.

Exact parent suggestions require a unique included explicitly marked box in the same worksheet. No relationship inference from names, indentation, styling, SN/PN or matching existing destination items.

Actual field edits preserve row order, full Notes, source coordinates and selection while invalidating approval. Read-only inspection and identical no-op edits preserve checked receipts. Busy, uncertain, departed, disposed, stale-kind and stale-sheet handlers cannot mutate old drafts.

Explicit English/Portuguese relationship headers identify Name-only inventory. Legacy Parent labels remain supported; ambiguous unqualified container identifiers show a manual-mapping notice and remain source Notes until deliberately mapped.

Located duplicate, missing, excluded, unmarked, cross-worksheet, self, cycle, depth and quantity errors require correction before save. Eight ancestor edges remain the native limit; Unknown and zero are preserved and box counts are never silently coerced.

Contained rows use the root box location before ledger review and native saving. Different reviewed mapped locations remain in full Notes as Mapped location before containment; overflow refuses rather than truncating retained evidence.

Safe append and identical retry preserve existing inventory items, count checks, task scope and custody. Existing 13-field draft/native schemas are retained; cross-worksheet and existing-destination box links are outside this import workflow.

Help explains relationship review and retained document/inventory workflows. Offline document, inventory and toolbox guidance is aligned inside the main content column. Import asset and cache versions advance to UI107.
